child_steps: Require owned cwd/interpreter and bind current production/client/runner/launcher source identities before network or secret load.

Set PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED=1 before any native authentication call; only the explicitly authorized parser reads the original checkout credential source and only the two allowlisted keys enter the current process environment.

Install output/exception containment and request budget before constructing the native client. Use production authentication method under a scoped bounded native-client factory or document direct installed-native construction; do not claim unmodified default retry settings.

Use native search(id=35300), then retrieve. search only primes the finite result and issues no HTTP request. Require exactly one returned dictionary with exact id35300 and a nonempty full_name; compare reported name/category to the retained control without inferring whole-dataset freshness.
Do not call run or _ensure_declared: those expand the selected cohort through parent/basonym links. Do not use existing raw cache as evidence of this fresh canary.

Preserve existing raw/API/web caches and transformed graph outputs. If retaining a public taxon response, validate its shape and secret absence first and save only to a unique evidence candidate file, never the authentication response or headers.
Save fixed status, publicID, HTTP status, timing, request counts, source/package identities and boolean success; failures remain failures with no empty-result inference.
canary_proposal.command_note: Concrete helper implementation/name remains root-owned. Arguments contain only mode, unique label and public record ID, never credential values. Standard launcher starts without either LPSN credential.
canary_proposal.launcher: Owned .venv/bin/python -B scripts/adhoc/kgm_rebuild_20261105.py launch lpsn-auth-canary-20261106-r1 -- <reviewed checkout-owned continuation helper> canary
canary_proposal.purpose: Verify authorized authentication and one fresh exact-ID native API response; no source-completion/freshness or graph-admission claim.

retained_control.interpretation: Real retained native/API and current GSS record, not the synthetic1002unit-test fixture.

suggested_bounds.note: A connect/read tuple alone is not a hard wall-clock deadline. Enforce the total bound separately and fail safely if it fires.

confirmed_safe_or_supported_behavior.fact: python-dotenv1.2.3 checks PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED before find_dotenv and before any DotEnv file parsing. Setting1 in the child prevents the native production load_dotenv call from reading other keys/files.

Existing phase helper records credential availability booleans and a fixed command only; no explicit credential values enter its arguments/receipt. Its command nevertheless reruns both lpsn_api and microbedecoder, so it is not the selected single-source continuation path.

Normal successful authentication prints only a fixed success message. Username/password enter a form-encoded token POST; access/refresh tokens remain attributes in memory, and the API token enters the Authorization header rather than an exact-ID URL.

An explicit sources=[lpsn_api] request stays that one source while the normal dispatcher checks upstream completion, runs the native producer and performs its existing finalization/fingerprint path. It does not automatically rerun microbedecoder.

execution_boundaries_requiring_controls.fact: The launcher hashes serialized full child environment. Supplying credentials before launch would create credential-derived provenance even though plaintext is not written.
execution_boundaries_requiring_controls.required_boundary: Launch with neither LPSN key present. The already-started stage-owned runner performs the user-authorized nonexecuting allowlisted parse and installs only the two values in its process environment. Do not call launcher.environment/launch again or serialize/hash os.environ after this load. No source-file/content hash of the credential file.

execution_boundaries_requiring_controls.fact: The installed client interpolates Keycloak errors and prints raw API error bodies. Keycloak error text may be the response message or full body. Native producer, dispatcher and launcher then print/persist exception text and traceback. These are concrete unfiltered sinks, not evidence that an actual credential was disclosed.
execution_boundaries_requiring_controls.required_boundary: Suppress potentially secret-bearing client output for initialization, API retrieval and later token refresh, and replace exceptions before they reach native outer printing or launcher repr. Suppression must cover preconfigured logging handlers/file descriptors where applicable, not only a contextlib stdout redirect. Never serialize request/response headers, auth form/body, token response, client.__dict__, exception repr/str, traceback locals or captured secret-bearing output. Emit only fixed failure classes and nonsecret counters/status codes.

execution_boundaries_requiring_controls.fact: Default client uses10authentication loops with50-second delays, API retry total10 and300-second timeout. Keycloak separately retries POST once. Expired-token handling recursively refreshes/reissues the fetch. Exhausted constructor authentication prints an error and returns without necessarily creating token attributes.
execution_boundaries_requiring_controls.required_boundary: Canary must enforce one authentication POST plus one exact-ID GET at the actual transport boundary, with no redirects, transport retries or refresh-loop requests; use bounded connect/read timeouts and an explicit total deadline. Verify actual nonempty access/refresh token attributes in memory before retrieval; never record their values.

findings_handling: Root owns issue filing and guarded-runner implementation. This review does not authorize weakening production semantics, native evidence checks or source admission, and no authenticated request has been made by this reviewer.

production_continuation_boundary.prerequisites: Bind the existing successful canonical phase3receipt and the separately completed MicrobeDecoder admission to the same full canonical plan and current input/source identities before loading credentials. Recheck the guards immediately before native dispatch. Do not claim phase4complete from the MicrobeDecoder-only receipt.
production_continuation_boundary.scientific_limits: A successful authentication canary does not refresh the full preserved cache or certify every LPSN record. Native _fetch catches per-record failures and increments errors while continuing; ensure the continuation reports/holds any actual failures and does not equate empty/API misses with transport success. Existing native source finalization and later production admission remain mandatory.
production_continuation_boundary.secret_scope: Run the native dispatcher in-process inside the already-started credential-free launcher child. Keep secret containment active through native API fetches and token refresh; clear the two environment entries before any post-run evidence path that could hash/serialize environment. Never put credential/token values in child argv.

review_scope.source_reads: Named production/launcher and installed dependency source files only; bounded public taxonomy cache/GSS records.
